content.json:
# Network Observability

NSG flow log analysis, connectivity health, bandwidth utilization, firewall rule hits, and DNS resolution monitoring.

content.query:
// NSG Flow Log summary – top source IPs by flow count, split by allowed vs denied
AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where SubType_s == 'FlowLog'
| summarize
    AllowedFlows = countif(FlowStatus_s == 'A'),
    DeniedFlows  = countif(FlowStatus_s == 'D')
    by SrcIP_s
| extend TotalFlows = AllowedFlows + DeniedFlows
| top 20 by TotalFlows desc
| project SourceIP = SrcIP_s, AllowedFlows, DeniedFlows, TotalFlows
content.title: Top 20 Source IPs by Flow Count

content.query:
// Allowed vs Denied flow trend over time
AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where SubType_s == 'FlowLog'
| summarize
    Allowed = countif(FlowStatus_s == 'A'),
    Denied  = countif(FlowStatus_s == 'D')
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Allowed vs Denied Flows Over Time

content.query:
// Failed connections by destination IP and port
AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where SubType_s == 'FlowLog' and FlowStatus_s == 'D'
| summarize DeniedCount = count() by DestIP_s, DestPort_d, NSGRule_s
| top 25 by DeniedCount desc
| project Destination = DestIP_s, Port = toint(DestPort_d), NSGRule = NSGRule_s, DeniedCount
content.title: Top Denied Connections by Destination

content.query:
// Bandwidth utilization – bytes in/out by source/destination pair (top 15)
AzureNetworkAnalytics_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where SubType_s == 'FlowLog'
| summarize
    BytesSrcToDst = sum(BytesSrcToDst_d),
    BytesDstToSrc = sum(BytesDstToSrc_d)
    by SrcIP_s, DestIP_s
| extend TotalBytes = BytesSrcToDst + BytesDstToSrc
| top 15 by TotalBytes desc
| project Source = SrcIP_s, Destination = DestIP_s,
         SentMB = round(BytesSrcToDst / 1048576.0, 2),
         ReceivedMB = round(BytesDstToSrc / 1048576.0, 2),
         TotalMB = round(TotalBytes / 1048576.0, 2)
content.title: Bandwidth Utilization — Top Source/Destination Pairs

content.query:
// Firewall rule hit analysis – AzureDiagnostics for Azure Firewall
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Category == 'AzureFirewallNetworkRule' or Category == 'AzureFirewallApplicationRule'
| extend RuleAction = extract(@"Action:\s*(\w+)", 1, msg_s)
| summarize HitCount = count() by Category, RuleAction, Resource
| order by HitCount desc
content.title: Firewall Rule Hit Analysis

content.query:
// DNS resolution failures from Azure Diagnostics
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Category == 'DnsAnalyticsLog'
| where ResponseCode_s != 'NOERROR' and ResponseCode_s != ''
| summarize FailureCount = count() by QueryName_s, ResponseCode_s, ClientIP_s
| top 25 by FailureCount desc
| project QueryName = QueryName_s, ResponseCode = ResponseCode_s, ClientIP = ClientIP_s, FailureCount
content.title: DNS Resolution Failures

content.query:
// Network Connection Monitor – test results over time
NWConnectionMonitorTestResult
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    SuccessCount = countif(TestResult == 'Pass'),
    FailCount    = countif(TestResult == 'Fail'),
    AvgLatencyMs = avg(AvgRoundTripTimeMs)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), TestGroupName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Connection Monitor Test Results Over Time
